functions.description: load and pack combatant resource script records
functions.notes: Only real difference: in the third packed triple (rec->third.middle) ours stores the word then reloads it (ldr r3,[r2,#8]) and accumulates into r0, target keeps the orr result in r1 and loads the 0xc00fffff mask before the str; this is the extra 4 bytes. Also mask-copy regs r4/r5/r7 order differs. Tried: colorsweep --apply (no help), records pointer local, reference vs pointer, rec declared at top, fourth as ResourceScriptPackedTriple, split pad, CopyTriple helper (merges stores, too short), fourth moved before third, local for valueC.middle, local order, ++ loops. None reduced the size.
